steps.title: 1-bit full adder: create native transistor schematic + physical layout and simulate all 8 inputs
Copy the actual hierarchy to the app clipboard
Parent wrapper: complete before/after preview; mask unchanged; approval required
Changing a parent name invalidates the old preview and approval
Approve the displayed parent and commit one revision
Undo and redo the approved hierarchy; original circuit and mask preserved
Paste copied root as a separated child with explicit pin mapping and show whole native impact
Four-bit ripple adder: real 512 combinations and reusable FA child cells
Programmable four-bit CPU: native physical reference and all 16 clocked instructions
